INSERT INTO ranking_snapshot (snap_date, investor_type, trade_type, market, rank, stock_code, stock_name, net_buy_amount, net_buy_volume) VALUES
(#{v.snapDate}, #{v.investorType}, #{v.tradeType}, #{v.market}, #{v.rank}, #{v.stockCode}, #{v.stockName}, #{v.netBuyAmount}, #{v.netBuyVolume})
ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_ranking_snapshot DO UPDATE SET stock_code = EXCLUDED.stock_code, stock_name = EXCLUDED.stock_name, net_buy_amount = EXCLUDED.net_buy_amount, net_buy_volume = EXCLUDED.net_buy_volume
